name: Yogurt Berry Pots with Oat Crumble
steps: Toast the oats with the oil and cinnamon in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden; cool.
Stir the vanilla and chia seeds into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt and berries in two glasses, finishing with a layer of berries.
Top with the oat crumble just before serving.
note: Over 20 g protein with no added sugar; the berries provide the sweetness.
